summary: This clinical trial is testing the addition of the drug metformin for people who have type 2 diabetes and heart failure, a condition where the heart does not pump blood as well as it should. The study is sponsored by October University for Modern Sciences and Arts and aims to include 80 participants. Researchers will look at how often patients need to go to the hospital and measure their quality of life. The current status of this research is Unknown status.
